objective: Test whether a high-clearance Cartesian right source-to-pregrasp path removes seed 101's nonselected-bowl contact without regressing the same-pattern seed 106 control.

baseline_evidence.seed_101_failure: safety failure during bowl1:candidate_0_pregrasp: right_clamp_right_link contacted nonselected bowl2
baseline_evidence.seed_106_control: baseline source approach completed; replay later failed at bowl1 placement XY

single_control_variable.name: right_source_to_candidate_pregrasp_path
single_control_variable.candidate_definition: Within the unchanged single 0.5-second pregrasp command, solve four Cartesian waypoints from front clearance to candidate pregrasp XY at unchanged front-clearance Z, then four vertical-descent waypoints to the unchanged candidate pregrasp pose.
unchanged: source reset, side assignment, candidate tuples, candidate search order, and candidate index semantics
front-clearance and candidate-pregrasp endpoints and right TCP orientation
one pregrasp command and its 0.5-second duration
candidate approach, close, contact requirement, fallback, lift, transport, placement, release, retreat, and success behavior
IK solver, tolerances, safety rules, collision geometry, clocks, assets, and task horizon

downstream_policy.accepted_terminal_action: Combine with the separately accepted left source route only in a fresh isolated candidate, then address replay contact, placement XY, and task-horizon failures independently.
downstream_policy.rejected_terminal_action: Preserve the result and return to right-source path geometry; do not change safety rules or ignore nonselected-bowl contact.

forbidden: modify or overwrite remote v131 or v135
change a second controller, safety, timing, tolerance, candidate, geometry, placement, or horizon variable
capture, export, collect, train, retry, or replace a panel seed
stop or modify another user's process
submit, create a pull request, contact an external party, or publish
claim_boundary: Isolated scripted-expert right source-pregrasp path panel only; not ten-seed expert, dataset, ACT, learned-policy, AMD/ROCm, competition-score, hardware, or real-robot evidence.
